title: Chapter 63: Someone’s in the House
html:
“Auntie sure cares about you.”

“Of course.” Inspector Lee put his phone away, and his face twisted with confusion. “Wait, just who do you think you are? You call me uncle and my wife auntie?”

No answer came. When Inspector Lee looked back, Chen Ge was already asleep. At New Century Park, he shook the young man awake. Chen Ge climbed out in a daze, backpack in hand.

“Be careful at all times! Zhang Peng is still out there. Based on the current situation and his twisted mentality, he might give up everything just to take revenge on you,” Inspector Lee reminded Chen Ge.

“I know.” Zhang Peng’s name woke Chen Ge somewhat. He waved goodbye and entered New Century Park. The elderly guard slept through his arrival.

Tonight’s reward is quite valuable. I can ask for a favor from Zhang Ya since I’ve completed her Bloody Heart Mission, but would it be too much of a waste to have her eliminate the mirror monster for me?

Chen Ge pulled out the black phone and clicked into Zhang Ya’s page. The affection level had been raised from “Crazy about you” to “Yours forever.”

I need to think carefully if I’m going to make the most of this chance.

As he entered the Haunted House, Chen Ge did not exit the page but continued reading through the details on Zhang Ya.

Once I have enough money, maybe I should rent a place nearby. Sleeping in the staff breakroom starts to feel strange after a while.He walked down the dark corridor. Every corner of the Haunted House was so familiar that he could navigate it without light.

As he passed the first-floor restroom, its wooden door creaked in a nonexistent wind. The flimsy panel had warped further after his assault with the mallet. He moved to pull it shut and noticed the restroom window hanging half open.

Did I forget to close the window?Dawn brightened the sky outside. Chen Ge inspected the sill but found no footprints nearby. I’m probably imagining things because of all the stress.

Even so, Chen Ge took the mop leaning against the wall and headed for the control room. Cameras covered every corner of the Haunted House. A quick review would reveal whether anyone had entered.

Chen Ge pushed open the control-room door, sat at the desk, and booted the computer that stored all the surveillance footage. He found the feed from the camera outside the restroom and opened its recording.

He expected his caution to prove excessive. Several minutes later, a strange man appeared on-screen.

The man had his head lowered and quickly rushed down the corridor once he exited the toilet.

Someone came in. There’s another person hiding in the Haunted House!Chen Ge snapped fully awake. He knows about the camera outside the restroom, and he knows where he’s going. He must have been inside before.

Several cameras covered the corridor. When the intruder vanished from the first feed, Chen Ge opened the next camera, positioned at the corner leading to the restroom. It showed the man racing down the hall and turning into the control room.

He went straight to the control room, probably to destroy the evidence. He knows the Haunted House’s layout.

Only one name came to mind. Before he could investigate further, he saw himself enter the frame.

The recording has caught up to the present. That’s me entering with the black phone and the mop… Wait. That means the man never left!Chen Ge seized the mop and spun around.

A locker two meters behind him burst open. A bloodshot-eyed man lunged out with a knife.

“Zhang Peng!” Chen Ge shouted at the sight of his twisted face. The cry provoked him. Zhang Peng charged with the knife, but Chen Ge recovered from the shock, opened the door behind him, and retreated while fending off the attack.

Despite his injured hand, Zhang Peng fought with the fury of a man who no longer valued his life. Knowing he had reached the end, he wanted only to drag someone into death with him. Chen Ge dodged from side to side as he retreated toward the maintenance room. He appeared cornered, but that was part of the plan.

Zhang Peng had staked his life on the attack, making escape impossible. Chen Ge had to fight back, but the wooden mop could not stop him. He needed Doctor Skull-cracker’s iron hammer, which he had hidden in the maintenance room to avoid an awkward encounter with the police.

The assault intensified. Zhang Peng saw through the plan. He stopped avoiding the mop and let it strike him, intent only on closing the distance.

Chen Ge soon reached the maintenance-room door. He waited for the right moment to dive inside, but a sudden weight settled over him like a boulder.

“You’re going to die today!” Zhang Peng, who had been silent, suddenly cried out. Spirit had returned to the man’s eyes, and his knife skill became much more agile.

What’s happening? Was the mirror monster controlling Zhang Peng until now? Then where is it?Chen Ge’s movements slowed. He reached behind himself but felt nothing. A crushing pressure forced his shoulders down. Turning his head, he saw a man-sized black shadow riding on his back.

The mirror monster!

Panic flashed in his eyes. Chen Ge ducked beneath a slash aimed at his neck, crashed through the maintenance-room door, and ran toward the cupboards packed with junk.

I can’t give up yet. Zhang Peng and the black shadow share one body. If I incapacitate Zhang Peng with the hammer, I can stop the shadow too!

A small mountain seemed to cling to Chen Ge’s back. He had underestimated the black shadow’s growth; since their first encounter, it had become far more dangerous.

The growing weight strangled the breath in his throat. A chorus of alien laughter filled his ears, and by the time he reached the cupboard, exhaustion had hollowed him out.

His consciousness wavered, and a dull hum filled his ears. Without looking back, Chen Ge knew Zhang Peng was approaching with the knife.

The monster bore down harder. Chen Ge used his last strength to wrench open the cupboard. As he dug through the debris for the hammer, the black phone slipped from his pocket, its screen still displaying Zhang Ya’s profile.
